productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 19 January 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: A 5-star customer service and an awesome little printer
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I don't know where to begin, because I am overwhelmed by the customer service I received from Mark. I am not tech savvy at all and have particularly struggled with all kinds of printers my entire life. I am quite convinced that printers hate me. The reason why I chose this printer was that the pain of printing labels on A4 on a regular printer and taping them to boxes was greater than figuring out how this little one works. All the positive reviews about Arkscan customer service gave me the confidence and the push to give it a go. Also, I really like the idea of the label roll being hidden inside. The rest of the deceptively tiny printers required a long tray to hold fanfold labels. I wasn't into that at all.The printer came very well packaged - a great first sign. My MAC doesn't have a USB port and the printer came with a USB to USB-c adapter, thus I was excited to put it to test right out of the box.Arkscan made it so easy to go through the installation and label calibration process, which took about 15 mins. Their videos are super clear with zero ambiguity. If I could do it, anyone could. I have a few additional questions and got in touch with their support. Mark replied very promptly. He sent me links to additional videos that addressed all my questions and concerns. In addition, my power adapter came with a rattling sound and would not power on after the first try printing the labels. After confirming my amazon purchase, Mark shipped me the power adapter replacement, which arrived in just 2 days.The printer is quick and smart, doesn't take much space and I have tries 3 different kinds of labels with great success. I am so so happy and relieved I do not have to buy ink for it. The shipping process is now streamlined and it has helped me to be very productive now that the dreadful shipping label element is off the table. I even was able to figure out how to print 4x6 shipping labels that are non standard format.My favorite purchase in a very long time.Thank you Mark!!Grateful for all reviewers before me. I hope you find this helpful!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in Canada on 13 July 2021
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Before buying this printer, I tried other printers including "Brother", none of them works for Chitchats which is tricky to work with most inexpensive printers. I guess Chitchats has the same print setting as Stamps.com in US. Chitchats consider Zebra's format (ZPL) as default, this printer is the only inexpensive Zebra alternative I can find on the market. I also tried to print directly from Etsy, no problem at all.Plus, packaging is very neat and manual is very detailed and well explained with videos.Setting is very easy, and regular thermal paper roll works for this printer. (a lot of brand name printers don't accept regular paper roll).Overall a very satisfied purchase experience.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 24 April 2022
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: UPDATE: The printing was fairly light with my 9v 1500ma wall wart.  I just tried powering it with a 9v 3a adapter and the printing is now very dark and really perfect.  Also fyi you can buy this exact same printer on eBay for half the price Adafruit is charging.  Adafruit has notoriously bad tech support so no real advantage in buying from them.ORIGINAL REVIEW: I'm using this with an Arduino Mega.  There are all kinds of options available in Adafruit's library such as printing bold, wide, bar codes, and graphics -- but I'm just logging data, and simply sending commands such as Serial2.println(formattedString); and it works perfectly without the library.You only need four wires!  Power and ground: I'm using a 9v 1500ma wall wart; and serial TX and ground from the Arduino.  You don't need to even use RX on the Arduino unless you want to receive error messages.I bought a box of 50 rolls of 2.25"x50' thermal paper here on Amazon and it's perfect.The printer comes with a couple of Y-shaped clips that will hold the printer to the front of a panel should you want to mount it.  The wires come out the bottom of the printer so it's a little awkward to just set it on a table - I'm going to re-route the connectors out the back instead of the bottom.Also, although the Adafruit tutorial seems to say that you must use software serial, I'm just using one of the four built-in serial ports on my Mega.  You only need software serial if your Arduino doesn't have any more hardware serial ports to spare.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Ich habe das Gerät mit einem Raspberry Pi 3B mit Windows 10 IoT im Einsatz. Genau aufgrund dieser Konstellation habe ich mich für dieses Gerät entschieden, da ich es über die GPIO Pins ansteuern kann.Beim ersten Versuch (schnell, schnell anschließen) kam aber dann die Ernüchterung....es wird nur eine halbe Zeile geschrieben und die war nicht wirklich intensiv. Warum? Weil man ein dezidiertes Netzteil mit mindestens 5V und 2A nehmen sollte. Und siehe da, kaum gewechselt, schon kommt der Ausdruck!Auf der Homepage des Herstellers sind viele Infos wie zB das Befehlsset, das Wiring, Codesamples, etc. erhältlich....das hilft ungemein, wenn man den Drucker noch nie in den Händen hatte!Bin sehr zufrieden und werde ihn wieder kaufen, so ich einen weiteren benötige!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 31 January 2019
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I was able to get this set up and running in about an hour with an Arduino Nano. The example code and tutorial on the Adafruit site are spot on. I was able to design a 3D-printable case for it also, with space inside for a spare roll of paper and the controller board for power and Bluetooth connectivity.For those looking to get into this, the command set in all the Arduino-compatible libraries is pretty easy to use. It's not direct ESC/POS command set compatible, but I don't see that as a bad thing per se.Just make sure you have a power supply that can handle the current, as thermal printers do require a fair amount. I used a 9V 2A DC power supply and it does work nicely with it. If you use a 5V 1.5A, you may find it doesn't work quite as well.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 25 June 2019
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Perfect for occasional large (5000+ page) printing tasks
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Twice a year I need to print date(s) and an address on pre-printed, full color, thin, single page invitations.  I used to use a local print shop, however the cost was significant.  This printer is able to print the required information using a simple word document with a text box in the correct location for about $30 in toner.  Using the default settings (600 dpi) and a standard USB 1.1 printer cable it prints approximately 26 ppm for this task, or 500 pages in 19 minutes, roughly 1,500 invitations in an hour.  I print batches of 500, immediately reloading the printer with the invitations for another batch.  The quality is excellent.  So far I have printed the date/location on 4,000 invitations without a single paper jam, ink splotch, or other defect that I've been able to detect.  Overall, this is an excellent, reasonably priced solution for this task.  As of yet the original 3,000 page toner cartridge has shown no signs of running out (likely because each page is only a small fraction of the type on a full page document).  Highly recommended for any similar printing task. I will say, you have to monitor it as the output tray only holds around 200-250 pages, so you have to grab them off every few minutes. Also, I'm not sure how to achieve the rated 48 ppm, but you likely have to set it to the minimum 300 dpi which does slightly degrade the quality. Standard settings are fast enough for me.UPDATE: I finished my printing task. The original toner lasted 5,000 pages. I purchased a 3rd party toner (E-Z ink) which worked excellent and is much less expensive than Brother. I let someone else complete the same task using this printer. In total we printed appx 12,000 invitations quickly and with no page jams or other issues whatsoever. Highly recommend.UPDATE 2: After 20-25,000 or so pages, I started to have some issues with the toner not transferring to the pre-printed invitation. I wasn't sure if this was due to using aftermarket ink or another issue. I found that by checking the setting "improve toner fixing" the problem was solved.Find it here:PROPERTIES > ADVANCED > OTHER PRINT OPTIONS > IMPROVE PRINT OUTPUT > IMPROVE TONER FIXING

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 8 June 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Almost 6 months and all is good
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Edit: almost 6 months now and I  have not experienced any issues. IMO it is a great printer. Purchased using amazon monthly payments.Previous:Still have not experienced any issues at all. Great printer, would buy again. It replaced my ~15 year old Brother HL-5240 that finally died. This Brother HL-L6200DW is still exceeding my expectations.Review from day 8:1268 Total Page Count so far, 1134 2-sided  and have experienced none of the issues that some have reported so far. I updated the firmware to the latest, "Main Version: 1.81" and Sub1 Version 1.75".I'm using 24lb Hammermill laser paper bought here on amazon.Power cord is embossed with "16AWG", most/all aftermarket power cords turned up by searching for "Brother HL-L6200 power cord" are 18AWG. The power cord for the HL-L6200DW must be rated for at least 13 amps which means you must use at least a 16AWG cord. I went with a 15 foot 14AWG Monoprice brand cord from amazon - it was less expensive than other brands of both 16AWG and 14aWG cords. 14AWG cords are rated at 15 amps.Since peak power is approximately 1368 watts, it does take a bit of current to get the fusers up to a temperature of nearly 400ºF to fuse the toner to paper,  those that use the old 18AWG power cord that was used on their old printer or go with a longer 18AWG cord might just have issues with smelling something burning.1200 dpi resolution and set to"Print in Black" so things like the text in the headers in Word always are in dark black. Print quality is, IMO, excellent. IMO lower settings and using toner saving mode probably would equal lower print quality.No idea if the settings to reduce paper curl and density adjustment might resolve some of the complaints but there are advanced settings that can be tried.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: When my primary work printer (an HP m604n laserjet) developed an issue with the feeding tray on the front, I decided to try this as a secondary printer while I send the HP off to be repaired.  Both printers have very similar specifications.  This Brother prints at 48 ppm and the HP prints at 52 ppm.  Both hold just over 500 sheets in the main tray.  Both are wireless enterprise printers.  Both can take high yield cartridges.  However, the HP costs $750+ compared to this Brother that I snagged on Amazon for $174!  Not to mention the replacement high yield toner is significantly cheaper than the HP ($122 for the 12,000 yield brother while the HP 10,000 yield 81A cartridge is like $190).The first print did leave a crease/wrinkle in the page.  So, I was thinking I got a lemon after looking at some of the other reviews.  I opened the machine up and inspected everything and tried again and haven't had a creased page print since (now at about 500 pages in).  Some reviews mention this being a power hungry printer and they are not wrong.  When I click print, it dims my desk lamp for a split second!  I am not sure why a printer requires such a power draw?  It is not a dealbreaker to me though.All in all, this printer is an excellent value for the price.  The print quality is almost identical to my HP and the print and initial print times are excellent.  Would definitely buy again.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 6 July 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Excellent Printer!  Here's what you need to know...
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Okay, this little printer is awesome for what it does.  Is it the most perfect printer ever?  No.  However, with a few little tips, it is an amazing little device.  Here's what I have found.1. In my opinion, the transparent papers print the best.  They seem to have more clarity than the white, solid papers.  But, I do like the white paper for simple projects that I'm not terribly worried about the look.  Let's be real, I keep all the papers on hand.2. I find that printing on the "heavy" setting for files that are mostly text looks the best.  Files that are mostly picture, take some trial and error to find a good print setting.  For me, the best looking settings are the "medium" and "heavy," but that's personal preference.3. Use a different app to design what you need.  I've made all kinds of labels and such, but as much as I love this printer, the design features in the app are lacking.  So, I've started using other apps like Canva to design what I need and then either export it as a picture or PDF and print it.  Works like a charm!  They way I see it, I paid for the printer, not the app, so this workaround works for me.Overall, I'm very impressed with how much this little printer can do.  It can print so many file types and that is awesome.  I actually love this printer enough that I've bought like 7 of them and given them to nieces and nephews for birthdays.  The kids love keeping a smash book/journal since it's an easy way for them to use their technology but still keep some fun memories in a physical book.  It allows them to be as creative or not as they want.  I work with youth at my church and they also love when I bring this printer to activities.  They make stickers and labels with memes and it's a lot of fun for them.I highly recommend this little printer.  I also have the M04 for larger printing and I love that one too.  One last piece of advice, check both the Phomemo website and Amazon for papers.  A lot of the time, the papers are cheaper directly on their site and you have more control of the variety you purchase.

Der Drucker wurde bei mir vor Ort von einem Linux-Experten mehrfach mit unterschiedlichen Treibern installiert und konfiguriert. Lief leider nicht stabil in diesem Betriebssystem. Nach einigen Aufgaben in Libre oder Softmaker war die Konfiguration jedes Mal "zerschossen" und es wurde nur noch "Grütze" ausgespuckt.Hab dann den Drucker mal mit der Installations-CD an einen Windows-Rechner angeschlossen. Ergebnis: No problem. Läuft mit Windows einwandfrei. Aber da ich definitiv dieses Betriebssystem nicht wollte, kann ich (als Linux-User) den Kauf nur als Fehlkauf bewerten. Schade.Frage: Ist Postscript nicht gleich Postscript?Wenn mir jemand eine Lösung aufzeigt, will ich den Kauf wohl gern anders bewerten.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 12 November 2022
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Love my printer, so far so good
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have had this printer since the pandemic, Fall 2020, almost 2 years and so far really happy with it. It was easy for me to set up on the Mac. We have an ethernet cable plugged into the wifi box and that makes it wireless for the studio. The print quality is great and it works consistently for us for what we do (printing out drafts of photo books). One drawback it has though, it's speed, a 300 page book takes hours to print. It's slow. But then again, the convenience of having this done in-house weighs out having to go to the copy shop to print drafts, which we have done previously. So far nothing else to complain. I have it on a cool looking dolly with rolls, rolling it in and out from under a desk, it's huge but so is the capability to print 11x17 pages.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 5 December 2016
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Old tech or just bad tech if you ask me
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Old tech or just bad tech if you ask me.  This replaced, believe it or not, an HP4050 that we had for over 20 years!  It finally failed and we thought we would getting something better but this printer is certainly not it.  First off, it weighs a thousand pounds - huge and wont fit well on a normal desk.  Next, it takes FOREVER to get itself configured.  You literally have to sit for a half hour for it to get ready.  Then, you go through a wait just to print and it takes the paper halfway through and stops AGAIN.  Please, the old 4050 would have printed out a book in that amount of time.  All these new HPs go through the same dance.  Printing takes forever.  And then, the paper is always fed in landscape making it a whole new issue for staff trying to get something to print correctly.  And you CANT change it!  And the printer driver is old fashioned.  Even our Dells are better - freakin Dell!  And the web interface is a joke.  And there was no Windows 10 drivers.  And the duplex unit DOESNT WORK - it jams every time!  And just about everything else on this POS is aggravating.  I suppose they make it 90 lbs to discourage you from returning it - but I would rent a forklift to get rid of this over-sized paper weight.  Buyer beware

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 24 March 2021
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Update after years of use: HP needs to update the drivers and have a real wireless option.  If you don't need 11 x 17, I'm sure you can find a printer where the company actually supports the product. We have found a couple of people at HP who know what to do but most have no knowledge of the product.  HP, you can do better!Love its ability to print duplex color up to 12 x 18, I believe.  I'm holding back one star as it is not wireless.  You can plug it into your router or network but that is an increasingly old school way of doing things.  The printer itself is built like a truck, a hard plastic one but a durable one it seems.Update: With the Window 11 update, the Jet Direct I used to print with this stopped working.  HP doesn't support a fix.  Also, the double sided printing went away.  I've had this one year and HP barely supports it despite a warranty.  Given this is an old printer, be careful as HP isn't really a reliable partner on this.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 7 December 2012
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: HP Color LaserJet Professional CP5225dn Printer Performs Great!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: My company has been using a big corporate color copier on lease with the full finishing attachment and it was great while it lasted!  But, unfortunately due to the economy, we have terminated the lease and moved on to printing more economically.Enter the HP Color LaserJet Professional CP5225dn Printer.  This printer does not have all the bells and whistles of a fully automated color copier, but it does print a great tabloid (11" x 17") sized paper with automatic duplexing.  Thus, we are not hindered by the lack of Finisher but are realizing the economic saving of not paying a monthly lease.We print our newsletters and flyer for direct mailing, utilizing the duplex tabloid printing with great color.  Yes, we fold and staple by hand, but it is a minor inconvenience to the personnel.I would recommend to everyone that if you want a simple duplex + letter or tabloid printing + great color + color laser resolution, then this printer is for you!!!!  CYuen.

Product Description
Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder 
The Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder is a versatile solution, specially engineered to deliver precise and high-quality printing on curved surfaces. Ideal for industries dealing with cylindrical or irregularly shaped items such as bottles, pipes, cans, and tubes, this handheld printer ensures that each print is sharp, clear, and consistent, regardless of surface shape. 
Precision Printing on Curved Surfaces: The inbuilt encoder ensures accurate, distortion-free printing on cylindrical or irregularly shaped objects like bottles, cans, pipes, and tubes.
Automatic Speed Adjustment: The integrated encoder adjusts print speed according to the movement of the surface, ensuring consistent and aligned prints even on dynamic, uneven surfaces.
High-Resolution Output: Capable of delivering crisp, clear prints with a resolution of up to 600 DPI, ideal for printing barcodes, logos, and text on curved materials.
Versatile Material Compatibility: Supports a variety of surfaces including plastic, metal, glass, wood, and more, making it adaptable for various industrial applications.
Quick-Drying, Smudge-Free Inks: Uses fast-drying inks that prevent smudging and ensure long-lasting, durable prints on both porous and non-porous curved surfaces.
Ergonomic and Portable Design: Lightweight and ergonomically designed for ease of use, providing comfort for long periods of operation, ideal for industries that require mobility.
Rechargeable Battery for Long-Lasting Use: Features a powerful, rechargeable battery that allows extended operation without frequent recharging, perfect for high-demand environments.
User-Friendly Touchscreen Interface: Equipped with an intuitive touchscreen display for easy control, setup, and real-time adjustment of print parameters.
For businesses that require precise and reliable printing on curved surfaces, the Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder delivers unparalleled performance and efficiency, making it the perfect tool for high-quality, professional-grade marking and coding. 
Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer 
12.7mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet ABS Model 
The 12.7mm Handheld TIJ ABS Model is 
Compact and Lightweight: Constructed from ABS plastic, this model is highly durable while being lightweight and portable, making it easy to carry and use on the go.
High-Quality Prints: With a print resolution of up to 600 DPI, the 12.7mm print head delivers clear, crisp results for barcodes, text, and logos.
Versatile Applications: Capable of printing on multiple surfaces, including cardboard, plastic, wood, metal, and more, allowing for a wide range of industrial and packaging needs.
Fast-Drying Ink: Uses fast-drying, smudge-resistant ink cartridges, ensuring high-quality prints that last on any material.
User-Friendly Interface: The 4.3-inch touch screen allows for quick operation and easy adjustments.
ABS Material: Known for its strength and impact resistance, the ABS plastic construction ensures that the printer can withstand the rigors of tough environments, from warehouses to manufacturing floors.
12.7mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer Metal Body 
The 12.7mm Handheld TIJ Printer with Metal Body is designed for high-performance printing in demanding industrial environments 
Durable Metal Construction: Built with a strong metal body, this printer is highly resistant to impact and wear, providing a long-lasting solution for heavy-duty applications.
Long Battery Life: Features a rechargeable battery that provides extended usage, allowing for continuous printing without frequent recharging.
Product Coding and Marking: Perfect for printing barcodes, batch numbers, logos, and expiration dates on packaging and products across various industries.
Retail & E-Commerce: Enables fast, professional labeling of goods and packages for e-commerce businesses.
Adjustable Print Height: The 12.7mm print head allows you to easily adjust print sizes, offering flexibility to meet specific printing needs.
24.5mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The 24.5mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer is a cutting-edge device designed for large-format printing with high precision and flexibility. 
Large Print Height (24.5mm): Enables wider and larger prints, perfect for creating prominent labels, logos, and text on large surfaces.
Professional Quality: The combination of high print resolution, versatile ink options, and fast-drying capabilities ensures that your prints maintain a professional finish, even in challenging environments.
Multi-Surface Capability: Prints efficiently on materials like plastic, cardboard, metal, wood, fabric, and more, providing flexibility for a wide range of applications.
Low Maintenance: ABS construction ensures minimal upkeep, and the intuitive touch screen simplifies day-to-day use.
Portable and Lightweight: Designed for ease of use and transport, allowing operators to perform on-the-go printing with minimal effort.
50.8mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The 50.8mm Handheld TIJ Printer is designed for large-format, high-resolution printing on a wide variety of surfaces. 
Large Print Height (50.8mm): The wide print head allows for larger and more prominent prints, making it ideal for creating extensive labels, logos, and detailed barcodes.
Warehouse and Logistics: Useful for labeling pallets, crates, and shipping materials, providing clear and precise identification for tracking and inventory management.
High-Quality and Versatile Prints: Whether it's for branding, logistics, or industrial marking, this printer ensures high-resolution, durable prints on any surface.
Portable and Sturdy Design: Despite its larger print capability, the handheld printer remains lightweight and durable, making it portable and easy to use in different environments.
Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer V/S Inbuilt Encoder Printer for Curved Surface 
When choosing between a Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer and an Inbuilt Encoder Printer, both offer unique benefits, but their use cases vary based on application requirements and operational settings. 
Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer: 
Portability: A handheld TIJ printer is designed for flexibility and mobility, allowing users to print on products in various locations without being tied to a specific production line. Its compact, lightweight design makes it ideal for on-the-go printing across different workstations or job sites.
Ease of Use: These printers are user-friendly, requiring minimal setup. Operators can manually position the printer on various surfaces and adjust the printing position as needed. It's perfect for small-scale production or businesses needing flexibility in their printing processes.
Versatile Printing Surfaces: Handheld TIJ printers can print on a wide variety of surfaces such as plastic, metal, wood, glass, and more, making them highly adaptable for industries like FMCG, pharmaceuticals, packaging, and logistics.
Applications: They are best suited for businesses that require occasional, flexible printing of barcodes, QR codes, logos, or MRP on irregular, large, or hard-to-reach surfaces. Small to mid-sized manufacturing setups or field operations find handheld printers more convenient.
Inbuilt Encoder Printer: 
Automation: Inbuilt encoder printers are typically integrated into automated production lines and equipped with encoders that ensure precise and consistent printing on fast-moving products. The encoder adjusts the print in real-time based on product speed, eliminating human error and ensuring accuracy.
High Speed & Volume: These printers are ideal for large-scale operations that require continuous, high-speed printing. Industries with large production volumes, such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, or automotive, benefit from this setup due to the efficiency of automated printing.
Consistency & Precision: Inbuilt encoders offer better print precision since the printer synchronizes with the movement of the conveyor belt. It guarantees that every print is placed perfectly on each product, regardless of its speed or size.
Fixed Installation: Unlike handheld TIJ printers, inbuilt encoder printers are stationary, requiring installation on production lines. While this limits mobility, it enhances automation, reducing the need for manual intervention.

The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 12.7mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a state-of-the-art printing solution designed for seamless integration into production lines. 
Large 7-Inch Touchscreen Display: The printer features a user-friendly 7-inch touchscreen interface, providing clear visibility and easy navigation for operators. This intuitive display allows for quick adjustments to settings, enabling efficient operation and reducing setup times.
High-Resolution Printing: With the capability to print at resolutions of up to 600 DPI
Versatile Printing Options: The 12.7mm printhead allows for flexible printing on various substrates, including paper, plastic, metal, and more. This versatility makes it suitable for a wide range of industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and consumer goods.
Radiance 7 inch Online Display 25.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 25.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a cutting-edge solution tailored for high-performance industrial printing needs. 
Wide 25.4mm Printhead: The 25.4mm printhead allows for broader printing coverage, making it suitable for a variety of applications, including larger packaging formats. This versatility is particularly beneficial for industries requiring extensive marking or coding.
Quick-Drying Inks: Designed to utilize fast-drying inks, the printer ensures smudge-free results that are ready for immediate handling. This feature enhances workflow efficiency in fast-paced production environments.
Easy Integration: The printer is designed for seamless integration into existing production lines, allowing for efficient operation alongside other equipment. This capability helps streamline processes and improve overall productivity.
Radiance 7 inch Online Display 50.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 50.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a high-performance printing solution designed 
Wide 50.4mm Printhead: The 50.4mm printhead allows for broader print coverage, accommodating larger packaging formats and enabling efficient printing on a variety of surfaces. This feature is particularly beneficial for industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and logistics.
Low Maintenance Requirements: With user-friendly features such as easy ink cartridge replacement and built-in cleaning functions, the Radiance TIJ printer minimizes maintenance needs, ensuring consistent performance with reduced downtime.
Compact and Durable Design: Its robust yet compact construction allows for easy installation in tight spaces, while also ensuring reliability in challenging industrial conditions.
You Can print 
A handheld thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer is a versatile device designed for on-the-go printing solutions, This compact and portable printer can efficiently print logos, barcodes, QR codes, manufacturing and expiry dates (MRP), batch numbers, and other essential product details. 
You can Print On 
A handheld thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer is a highly adaptable tool designed to print on various surfaces with precision and ease. Whether you need to mark products made of paper, cardboard, plastic, metal, glass, wood, or textiles, this portable device ensures clear, high-quality prints. 
Industrial Use 
A handheld thermal inkjet printer is a versatile printing solution that finds application across multiple industries, 
FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods): In the FMCG sector, handheld TIJ printers are used to print essential product information such as barcodes, QR codes, expiry dates (MRP), batch numbers, and branding elements on packaging materials like plastic, paper, and cartons. 
Pharmaceutical: In the pharma industry, handheld TIJ printers are critical for ensuring traceability and safety. They are used to print important details like manufacturing and expiry dates, lot numbers, barcodes, and serial numbers on blister packs, boxes, bottles, and labels. 
Wood: For the wood industry, handheld TIJ printers are useful for marking timber, plywood, and wooden crates with logos, dimensions, or batch numbers. 
Dairy: In the dairy industry, where product freshness and expiration dates are crucial, handheld TIJ printers are used to print on packaging like milk cartons, bottles, and pouches.

Product Description
Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder 
The Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder is a versatile solution, specially engineered to deliver precise and high-quality printing on curved surfaces. Ideal for industries dealing with cylindrical or irregularly shaped items such as bottles, pipes, cans, and tubes, this handheld printer ensures that each print is sharp, clear, and consistent, regardless of surface shape. 
Precision Printing on Curved Surfaces: The inbuilt encoder ensures accurate, distortion-free printing on cylindrical or irregularly shaped objects like bottles, cans, pipes, and tubes.
Automatic Speed Adjustment: The integrated encoder adjusts print speed according to the movement of the surface, ensuring consistent and aligned prints even on dynamic, uneven surfaces.
High-Resolution Output: Capable of delivering crisp, clear prints with a resolution of up to 600 DPI, ideal for printing barcodes, logos, and text on curved materials.
Versatile Material Compatibility: Supports a variety of surfaces including plastic, metal, glass, wood, and more, making it adaptable for various industrial applications.
Quick-Drying, Smudge-Free Inks: Uses fast-drying inks that prevent smudging and ensure long-lasting, durable prints on both porous and non-porous curved surfaces.
Ergonomic and Portable Design: Lightweight and ergonomically designed for ease of use, providing comfort for long periods of operation, ideal for industries that require mobility.
Rechargeable Battery for Long-Lasting Use: Features a powerful, rechargeable battery that allows extended operation without frequent recharging, perfect for high-demand environments.
User-Friendly Touchscreen Interface: Equipped with an intuitive touchscreen display for easy control, setup, and real-time adjustment of print parameters.
For businesses that require precise and reliable printing on curved surfaces, the Radiance Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer with Inbuilt Encoder delivers unparalleled performance and efficiency, making it the perfect tool for high-quality, professional-grade marking and coding.

Compact and Lightweight: Constructed from ABS plastic, this model is highly durable while being lightweight and portable, making it easy to carry and use on the go.

Fast-Drying Ink: Uses fast-drying, smudge-resistant ink cartridges, ensuring high-quality prints that last on any material.
User-Friendly Interface: The 4.3-inch touch screen allows for quick operation and easy adjustments.
ABS Material: Known for its strength and impact resistance, the ABS plastic construction ensures that the printer can withstand the rigors of tough environments, from warehouses to manufacturing floors.
12.7mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer Metal Body 
The 12.7mm Handheld TIJ Printer with Metal Body is designed for high-performance printing in demanding industrial environments 
Durable Metal Construction: Built with a strong metal body, this printer is highly resistant to impact and wear, providing a long-lasting solution for heavy-duty applications.
Long Battery Life: Features a rechargeable battery that provides extended usage, allowing for continuous printing without frequent recharging.
Product Coding and Marking: Perfect for printing barcodes, batch numbers, logos, and expiration dates on packaging and products across various industries.
Retail & E-Commerce: Enables fast, professional labeling of goods and packages for e-commerce businesses.
Adjustable Print Height: The 12.7mm print head allows you to easily adjust print sizes, offering flexibility to meet specific printing needs.

The 24.5mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer is a cutting-edge device designed for large-format printing with high precision and flexibility. 
Large Print Height (24.5mm): Enables wider and larger prints, perfect for creating prominent labels, logos, and text on large surfaces.
Professional Quality: The combination of high print resolution, versatile ink options, and fast-drying capabilities ensures that your prints maintain a professional finish, even in challenging environments.
Multi-Surface Capability: Prints efficiently on materials like plastic, cardboard, metal, wood, fabric, and more, providing flexibility for a wide range of applications.
Low Maintenance: ABS construction ensures minimal upkeep, and the intuitive touch screen simplifies day-to-day use.
Portable and Lightweight: Designed for ease of use and transport, allowing operators to perform on-the-go printing with minimal effort.
50.8mm Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The 50.8mm Handheld TIJ Printer is designed for large-format, high-resolution printing on a wide variety of surfaces. 
Large Print Height (50.8mm): The wide print head allows for larger and more prominent prints, making it ideal for creating extensive labels, logos, and detailed barcodes.
Warehouse and Logistics: Useful for labeling pallets, crates, and shipping materials, providing clear and precise identification for tracking and inventory management.
High-Quality and Versatile Prints: Whether it's for branding, logistics, or industrial marking, this printer ensures high-resolution, durable prints on any surface.
Portable and Sturdy Design: Despite its larger print capability, the handheld printer remains lightweight and durable, making it portable and easy to use in different environments.
Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer V/S Inbuilt Encoder Printer for Curved Surface 
When choosing between a Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer and an Inbuilt Encoder Printer, both offer unique benefits, but their use cases vary based on application requirements and operational settings. 
Handheld Thermal Inkjet Printer: 
Portability: A handheld TIJ printer is designed for flexibility and mobility, allowing users to print on products in various locations without being tied to a specific production line. Its compact, lightweight design makes it ideal for on-the-go printing across different workstations or job sites.
Ease of Use: These printers are user-friendly, requiring minimal setup. Operators can manually position the printer on various surfaces and adjust the printing position as needed. It's perfect for small-scale production or businesses needing flexibility in their printing processes.
Versatile Printing Surfaces: Handheld TIJ printers can print on a wide variety of surfaces such as plastic, metal, wood, glass, and more, making them highly adaptable for industries like FMCG, pharmaceuticals, packaging, and logistics.
Applications: They are best suited for businesses that require occasional, flexible printing of barcodes, QR codes, logos, or MRP on irregular, large, or hard-to-reach surfaces. Small to mid-sized manufacturing setups or field operations find handheld printers more convenient.
Inbuilt Encoder Printer: 
Automation: Inbuilt encoder printers are typically integrated into automated production lines and equipped with encoders that ensure precise and consistent printing on fast-moving products. The encoder adjusts the print in real-time based on product speed, eliminating human error and ensuring accuracy.
High Speed & Volume: These printers are ideal for large-scale operations that require continuous, high-speed printing. Industries with large production volumes, such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, or automotive, benefit from this setup due to the efficiency of automated printing.
Consistency & Precision: Inbuilt encoders offer better print precision since the printer synchronizes with the movement of the conveyor belt. It guarantees that every print is placed perfectly on each product, regardless of its speed or size.
Fixed Installation: Unlike handheld TIJ printers, inbuilt encoder printers are stationary, requiring installation on production lines. While this limits mobility, it enhances automation, reducing the need for manual intervention.

The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 12.7mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a state-of-the-art printing solution designed for seamless integration into production lines. 
Large 7-Inch Touchscreen Display: The printer features a user-friendly 7-inch touchscreen interface, providing clear visibility and easy navigation for operators. This intuitive display allows for quick adjustments to settings, enabling efficient operation and reducing setup times.
High-Resolution Printing: With the capability to print at resolutions of up to 600 DPI
Versatile Printing Options: The 12.7mm printhead allows for flexible printing on various substrates, including paper, plastic, metal, and more. This versatility makes it suitable for a wide range of industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and consumer goods.
Radiance 7 inch Online Display 25.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 25.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a cutting-edge solution tailored for high-performance industrial printing needs. 
Wide 25.4mm Printhead: The 25.4mm printhead allows for broader printing coverage, making it suitable for a variety of applications, including larger packaging formats. This versatility is particularly beneficial for industries requiring extensive marking or coding.
Quick-Drying Inks: Designed to utilize fast-drying inks, the printer ensures smudge-free results that are ready for immediate handling. This feature enhances workflow efficiency in fast-paced production environments.
Easy Integration: The printer is designed for seamless integration into existing production lines, allowing for efficient operation alongside other equipment. This capability helps streamline processes and improve overall productivity.
Radiance 7 inch Online Display 50.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer 
The Radiance 7 Inch Online Display 50.4mm TIJ Thermal Inkjet Printer is a high-performance printing solution designed 
Wide 50.4mm Printhead: The 50.4mm printhead allows for broader print coverage, accommodating larger packaging formats and enabling efficient printing on a variety of surfaces. This feature is particularly beneficial for industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and logistics.
Low Maintenance Requirements: With user-friendly features such as easy ink cartridge replacement and built-in cleaning functions, the Radiance TIJ printer minimizes maintenance needs, ensuring consistent performance with reduced downtime.
Compact and Durable Design: Its robust yet compact construction allows for easy installation in tight spaces, while also ensuring reliability in challenging industrial conditions.
You Can print 
A handheld thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer is a versatile device designed for on-the-go printing solutions, This compact and portable printer can efficiently print logos, barcodes, QR codes, manufacturing and expiry dates (MRP), batch numbers, and other essential product details. 
You can Print On 
A handheld thermal inkjet (TIJ) printer is a highly adaptable tool designed to print on various surfaces with precision and ease. Whether you need to mark products made of paper, cardboard, plastic, metal, glass, wood, or textiles, this portable device ensures clear, high-quality prints. 
Industrial Use 
A handheld thermal inkjet printer is a versatile printing solution that finds application across multiple industries, 
FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods): In the FMCG sector, handheld TIJ printers are used to print essential product information such as barcodes, QR codes, expiry dates (MRP), batch numbers, and branding elements on packaging materials like plastic, paper, and cartons. 
Pharmaceutical: In the pharma industry, handheld TIJ printers are critical for ensuring traceability and safety. They are used to print important details like manufacturing and expiry dates, lot numbers, barcodes, and serial numbers on blister packs, boxes, bottles, and labels. 
Wood: For the wood industry, handheld TIJ printers are useful for marking timber, plywood, and wooden crates with logos, dimensions, or batch numbers. 
Dairy: In the dairy industry, where product freshness and expiration dates are crucial, handheld TIJ printers are used to print on packaging like milk cartons, bottles, and pouches.

aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
LENVII Thermal Label Printer Shipping Label Printer-Compate with Windows & Mac and All Major Shipping Platforms and Marketplaces 
1.Print without ever needing to buy ink or toner. 
2.150mm/s printing speed and 203dpi resolution printing. 
3.Compatible with all types of direct thermal label paper. 
4.Compatible with Windows, Mac system. 
5.Compatible with all major shipping platforms and marketplaces. 
6.Quick start and setup with the included USB Flash Drive. 
7.Automatic identification, automatic detection and paper feed adjustment functions. 
9.Supports label widths ranging from 48-108mm. 
10.Packing（1*Label printer / 1*User Manuals / 1*USB disk / 1*External label holder / 1*Power adapter / 1*USB cable） 
High-Speed Printing,Printing 72 labels of 4x6 size per minute, the thermal printer supports up to 6IPS high-speed printing with low noise,saved so much time! 
Easy to Start,By downloading the driver from our U Disk , the installation of the label printer could be finished quickly. Shipping Label Printing Guide to help you set up the printer. 
Auto Label Detection,With the intelligent function of adjusting paper, thermal label printer could adjust the position automatically and precisely, making the process go smoothly. 
Easy to Open and Adjust,Turning the both-side switch button with you can easily open the inside of the printer. Then, you can manually adjust the paper position or clean the thermal print head. 
Dual media sensors ensure the shipping thermal label printer accurately positioned when printing.When loading paper, the printing side must face up, and the printer can automatically adjust the paper position. 
Easy to use and set up,Firstly, install the shipping label printer's driver. Secondly, connect the wire cord and USB cable to the label maker and the computer. Thirdly, loading the labels. Lastly, click the button to print! 
High-Speed Printing 
Printing 72 labels of 4x6 size per minute,saved so much time!With a resolution of 203dpi, crystal clear images and easy-to-read barcodes printed. 
Thermal label paper slot 
Media sensors ensure the shipping thermal label printer accurately positioned when printing.When loading paper, the printing side must face up, and the printer can automatically adjust the paper position. 
Easy to Open 
Turning the both-side switch button with you can easily open the inside of the printer. Then, you can manually adjust the paper position or clean the thermal print head. 
Compatible with Multiple Label Sizes 
Label printer supports different sizes of label papers,Great for shipping labels, warehouse labels, barcode labels, Amazon labels, product labels, address labels, ID labels, and more .support in width between 48-108mm. 
USB Disk Installation Driver 
Easy to use and set up,Desktop thermal label printer is equipped with a USB disk, which contains the installation printer driver, DIY edit label software, can help you set the printer. 
Packing List 
1*Label printer 
1*User Manuals 
1*USB disk 
1*External label holder 
1*Power adapter 
1*USB cable 
Product Specification 
Printing Method 	Direct Thermal 	
Printing Resolution 	203 dpi 	
Printing Speed Maximum 	150mm/s 	
Printing Width 	48-108mm 	
Compatible System 	Windows/Mac 	
Compatible Platform 	USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Shopify, PayPal, Shipstation Stamps.com etc. 	
Install Mode 	One step install with USB flash drive 	
Print Head Life 	50 km 	
Wide Application Areas 
Thermal Label Printer works as a regular printer that can print bar codes, texts, image or graphics, print anything you send to printer from windows’ and Mac’s devices. label printer addresses the rapidly increasing demands of logistics and express, E-commerce,warehouse, retail market and more. Provides quickly and high quality print, cost-effective, durable and reliable Thermal Label Printer. Designed to get you easy and efficient print, saves you both time and money when you are using it. 
Label Applications 
Bar-code labels, 4”x 6” shipping labels, address labels, postage labels, Amazon labels, commodity labels, warehouse labels, carton labels, ID labels, bulk mailing labels, multipurpose labels and more. 
No Toner No Ink 
Thermal technology, works with any direct thermal labels. No printer ink or toner needed. Make you an incredible low print cost. 
Print Multiple Size of Labels 
Prints labels from 1.57'' to 4.1'' in width and height from 1'' to 9.84'' including 4''x 6''/4''x 4''/4"x 3"/4''x 2''/4''x 1''/3''x 2''/2.25''x 1.25''/2''x 1'' main labels. 
Roll and Fan-fold Labels 
Supports roll or fan-fold labels loaded from back of the printer, better use with label holder especially for roll label papers. 
Making Label Printing Efficient 
Automatic label identification, no waste first label. Press and hold the top circular paper feeder button until you hear one beep and then release. It will automatically detect the size and characteristics of your label. 
How to download and set up driver for Windows/MacBook? 
Windows: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Windows driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
MacBook: Insert the USB disk→Open the (Mac driver) folder to get the drive→double click the driver software to install→ According to the system prompts can quickly complete the installation. 
(Please view the installation demonstration video on the USB drive before installation) 
Why does the test print only print out blank pages when the printer driver is successfully installed? 
1）Please check if the paper size setting of the printer is correct and adjust the scale and margins in preview page or page setup. 
2）Please check if the label sticker purchased is a thermal label sticker, the printer only supports printing thermal labels, no ink or toner or ribbon needed. 
(Check the label sticker method: please place the label paper in the printer, turn off the power, finger press the top button of the printer without releasing, turn on the power, wait for 2 seconds, finger release the top button, then the printer will automatically print the test page, such as normal print content, the label paper is thermal label paper. If there is no printed content, please replace the thermal label stickers) 
3）Please make sure your labels are properly loaded. The printing side is facing up. 
I installed the printer driver. Why am I still unable to print? 
(1) The printer needs to be powered on and connected to the computer prior to installing the driver. Please uninstall the driver and try to reinstallation. 
(2) The print port is occupied. Please go to the “Printer properties” of your computer and change a different USB port. 
Operation: Device and Printer→Printer Properties→Port→Select other USB port(USB001~USB005). 
(3) You have not successfully installed the driver. Please reinstall the corresponding operating system driver in the U disk. 
How to solve the problem of installing the installation operation? 
If you encounter problems in the installation / use process, we can provide you with remote service support.

aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
BENTSAI is a mature company specializes in producing portable handheld printers that can effectively raise productivity and save costs for businesses from all kinds. We have our own independent R&D, professional production line and world-wide sales channel. 
From mini size to wide format, BENTSAI portable handheld printers are made with superior quality components and have gone through strict quality control from raw materials to production. Every printers and cartridges are subject to multiple quality tests to ensure our customers get the best "Value for money". BENTSAI handheld printers literally make "Print at anywhere and anytime" with less money a reality. 
The revolutionary design of B10 mini makes printing no longer boring and confined to businesses. The B10 uses a combination of wireless, detachable components, and an extremely light weight of 195g. This palm-sized product allows you to carry it around easily. WIFI connection also allows you to print anything at anytime, bringing your logo, barcode, UPC code and other printing experiences to the next level! 
BENTSAI B10 Mini Printer 
Under proper conditions, B10 can print on rough, curved and other uneven surfaces. You can also use B10 to print temporary tattoos on the skin. In a safe way of use, any creative ideas can be realized by B10. Print any text and any graphic in high resolution with just a simple sideways movement across the surfaces. Fast dry ink has excellent adhesion and waterproof perforｍance on various materials. The printed content on the surfaces is solid, durable and stable, and will definitely impress the viewer. 
Wireless Operation 
B10 mini is battery-powered, , portable and super compact. However, it doesn't mean you have to sacrifice on the battery life. Battery provides 3 hours of working time, you can continue to use the printer while charging, no work progress will be slowed down. 
App Assisstance 
When B10 is connected to iPhone or Android using the PRTFOX app, you can easily realize your creativity at your fingertips. Endless templates such as multiple font styles, multiple data formats, batch variable barcode/QR code printing are all available. 
Print Anything 
Supports printing text, date, time, QR code, barcode, logo, tag, variable counter, variable QR code and variable barcode, etc. A perfect portable and mini tool for use in production, trade, logistics, warehousing, food, healthcare and construction businesses, etc. 
Print Anywhere 
B10 can print on rough, curved and other uneven surfaces. Printable materials includes: paper, metal, plastic, glass, cartons, wooden boxes, fiberboards, craft bags, PE and up to thousands of common materials on the market. 
Multi-color Options 
A new ink cartridge design developed by BENTSAI for special applications, including more challenging substrates, an outstanding decap, and ink with unusual solvent-based formula. We provide widely color options like Black, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Green, White and Invisible. Each printer can once have one ink cartridge for monochrome printing. 
Erasable with Alcohol 
The ink used for B10 is alcohol-erasable. When you print by mistake or you no longer want the prints on the surface, you can use alcohol to wipe it off. So don't worry about mistakes, feel free to unleash your creativity! 
Water Resistance 
The ink used for B10 provides excellent water resistance. You don't need to worry about rain damage to the print, also the accidentally spilling water on the printed surface. The ink provides solid waterproof protection. 
Incredible and Affordable 
The printing cost is only 1/10 of other mini handheld inkjet printers. Each ink cartridge can prints up to 2,000,000 characters which are approximately equal to word count of 8 novellas, or 108,000 "Hello" in 12.7mm height. 
Slide and Print 
The integrated encoder on the printer allows you to hold the printer in your hand and slide it straight across the surfaces, and the printout is still continuous and complete, no matter the speed. 
Note: 
1. Package includes: 1×USB Cable, 1×Mini B10 Printer, 1×Black Ink Cartridge, 1×Manual, 1×Packing Box. 
2. In order to ensure the normal charging of the printer, please prepare a 5V 1A plug. 
3. Multicolor printing is not supported. 
Ink Cartridge Maintenance 
Please shake the cartridge before use and wipe the printhead surface to make it clean. After use, please wipe the printhead surface again. If it’s not operating for more than 10 minutes, please cover the protective cap; if it’s not operating for more than 8 hours, please remove the cartridge from the printer and cover the protective clip of the cartridge in time to prevent the cartridge from drying out and blocking the nozzle. 
App Installation and Upgrade 
Scan the QR code inside the printer cap to download the PRTFOX APP on your phone. The app automatically receives update notifications, and with a simple update process on your phone, you can update in minutes. 
How to print consecutive number? 
Repeat print function is set as default in B10 printer. To print variable contents, you will need to turn off the repeat function first by following the steps below: 
• Connect B10 to PRTFOX APP 
• Click "Settings" icon at the top left corner 
• Click "Print" in Setting 
• Turn off the "Repeat print" at the bottom 
• Click the check icon 
After this setting your B10 should be ready to print variable contents. 
How to use the bulk print function? 
To bulk print, you could simply import single or multiple files to the phone. By creating multiple jobs, you could print different file at one work. 
What should I do if the printer cannot connect to the APP? 
1. After using the original password to connect to the wifi of the machine, select "Confirm Connection" on the pop-up prompt page 
2. If step 1 is unsuccessful, please forget the network and use the password again to connect to the wifi and then wait for 30s, the confirmation prompt for connecting to the network pops up, and then confirm the connection to the network.

description: What is Graphene Conductive Ink?  Conductive ink is a thick thermoplastic paste of conductive nanoparticles (Graphene, Graphite, carbon, and many more). It compromises solvents and surfactants that hold the conductive material together. Typically, on the application, the solvent and surfactants should evaporate, leaving the conductive materials behind. Graphene conductive ink is a thick paste made by adding solvents, surfactants, and Graphene powder. The product has its maximum usage in the field of printed electronics.Graphene has a 2-dimensional structure and honeycomb lattice shape and has a C-C bond contributing to the sp2 tightly bonded carbon. That makes Graphene the most flexible, thinnest, and strongest material in existence that conducts heat and electricity with great potential. It can carry conductive charges on a non-conductive surface.  How to Use Graphene Conductive Ink?  The Graphene ink comes in a jar or glass bottle. Before opening the lid, it is mandatory to shake the bottle vigorously and mix the ink well. It is a crucial step as the conductive nanoparticles accumulate at the bottom of the jar. Mixing regulates the product evenly in all places. With the help of an applier such as a brush or spray, apply the product on the surface of choice in the decided pattern. Set it aside for 20 minutes to let the ink dry. Optionally, the researcher can roll over it with a pin to compress the nanoparticle for better results.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: i've found that you have to put the photo paper tray under the printer in the compartment. The intermediate flap has two pockets on one side that you should be able to store spare print cartridges in, though i haven't tested it because i'm waiting on additional paper/cartridges to come in.  the side facing the printer is soft so it won't scratch the screen, and prevents other items stored above it from contacting the screen. The M51995A is equivalent to the M51977 with externally re- settable OVP(over voltage protection)circuit

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Extremely expensive, high maintenance, no service support.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Quality: not upto mark or say not even near to midrange monochrome printers. Color prints lack shades  of original and difficult to match with Adobe or Corel Color Profiles. Canon mentions it high-end printer but results are very low quality & granulated color prints.Installation of printer (hardware/device) is normal but software settings specific to top graphics software like Adobe, Corel, Autodesk are complicated and limited, not in depth.Service for printers other than primary laser printers (low end, priced below ₹20k) is totslly absent. No follow back or resolution to customers by after sales support division. No printer spares and consumables, toners made available in Canon centers, shops, dealers or in open market.In short go for this or similar Canon printers ImageClass or ImageRunners if you have money to waste on your passion or your customers are desperate to spend money on brand instead of quality.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Excellent hardware let down by very poor software - but there is a solution!!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought this as a refurb unit and after reading numerous reviews, I know why. The software has a major flaw which becomes apparent when you try to save your scanned images. The software crashes. I've tried on 2 different computers and the same thing happens.Also the scanner is advertised as having a scanning resolution of up to 1,200 DPI. It may well do but the software only supports up to 600 DPI.If you manage to save your scan quickly i.e. before the bug kicks in, you may well be able to use the scanner - however it is unlikely that you will find this satisfactory.I did though actually like the hardware. It is robust, scans quickly and is flexible in it's scanning capabilities.There is an alternative software solution using an open source scanning solution called NAPS (not another PDF Scanner) - which recognises the scanner and works perfectly - without the Save Bug.In summary HP have produced a solid scanner but the software provided and the apparent support (seen on other reviews) of the scanner appears to be very poor.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 27 May 2018
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: WONDERFUL AND POWERFUL SCANNER TO KEEP YOUR OFFICE PAPER-FREE
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This scanner is an amazing and very productive machine. I use it every week to digitize documents and recycle the paper. The quality of the scans at 600 PPI is great and the Adobe text recognition software (OCR) produces excellent results due to the high quality of the scans.I recommend to set the scanner to automatically recognize black&white or color pages, page sizes and to skip blank pages. If you reduce the settings to 400 PPI, it will work faster and the scanned files will be smaller.Adobe Acrobat is the PDF software that I use and it usually reduces the size of the scanned file between two and ten times by converting it to a PDF file that can be read with Adobe Acrobat X or later but not with earlier versions. The free Acrobat Reader can also read these reduced files as long as you use the latest versions.This scanner helped me save a few trees and recycle hundreds of pounds of paper and I highly recommend it.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 2 May 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Normally these work GREAT - recently purchased two and neither work very well
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: We purchase two of these "NEW" scanners in February.  One arrived looking really yellowed as if it had been sitting out of the box for a number of years, much like old office equipment from the 90's. The other one hasn't been able to scan one single page from day one.  We have tried everything including rejuvenating roller conditioner.  It's so disappointing since we rely on these scanners throughout our company and have multiple sites in use.  I am not sure that we actually got NEW ones or REFURBED ones that the seller presented and sold as new. :-( We missed our return window so now we are just out over $1,000. :-(

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 14 February 2019
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have been using Canon scanners for years.  The Capture Perfect software is wonderful and really sets the Canon scanners apart from the competition like Fujitsu.Pros:Software is amazing, if purchased new, it also comes with a PDF program license and Kofax key.High quality scansFastLots of useful features like ultrasonic sensor preventing double feedsCons:The tray at the bottom occasionally catches documents.- Solution, tape a piece of paper to keep the feeding tray "smooth" so documents wont snag where it extends.When overfilled, you have to jiggle the papers to get them to feed.-Solution, don't overfill the feeding tray.  The software allows continuous scanning so there is no need to over stuff the feeding tray.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 25 September 2018
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This desktop scanner is so easy to use and makes my job so much easier. I can scan documents directly to folders on my computer or directly to a printer. It scans small, odd shaped pieces of paper, such as receipts, too! Love it!

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 21 July 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: This states that it comes with Kofax Elite and after reading reviews people said they received the upgrade key. I never received the upgrade key, so only comes with Kofax Elite Basic. You can download that and to charge for the increase in price is a rip-off.  If you need Kofax Elite don't purchase!
